Subject: Infra strategy & private option — recap and next steps

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and the options we discussed so the rest of your team has a clear next step: 

Summary of what we heard
- Primary use case: batch document classification and occasional live chat for support agents (~20 concurrent)
- Key constraints: PII data in logs, 12-month retention policy, strict regional hosting preference (US-East)
- Success metric: <=150ms median token latency on assistant flows; predictable per-token unit cost target

Options we sketched
1) Hosted API (fastest): Minimal ops, lower time-to-value; good if ingestion can remove PII before sending.
2) Dedicated (reserved GPU pools): Predictable throughput and tenancy isolation; middle ground for cost/performance.
3) Private (VPC / on-prem): Full network isolation and customer-managed infra; best fit for regulated data with KMS/HSM integration.

Your signal that drove this note: you flagged procurement + security as blockers for hosted, and asked about our Private/VPC play.

Proposed next steps
- I can share a short Private readiness checklist and an initial SOW draft for procurement (attached).
- If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min ops/infra session with Laura (CS lead) and our security engineer to walk the checklist.
- We also suggested a 30-day canary pilot on a Dedicated pool as a lower-risk step before a full Private deployment.

Would you prefer: (A) checklist + SOW for procurement now, or (B) schedule the ops session first?

Thanks — I’ll hold off until I hear your preference.

—
